name: open-accountant

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name accountant --branch main
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --local --file schema/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --local --file schema/seed.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --remote --file schema/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --remote --file schema/seed.sql
scripts.sample: wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --local --file sample-data/accounts.sql && wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --local --file sample-data/rules.sql && wrangler d1 execute accountant-db --local --file sample-data/plan.sql && tsx cli/ingest.ts sample-data --config sample-data/ingest.config.json --local

description: A starter kit for a personal finance app you own: trusted ledgers, multi-currency, AI categorization, a cash forecast and an MCP server, on Cloudflare.
